observations.title: Driver hired against the position of Life Guard
observations.description: During the branch audit, it was observed that an employee Mr. Abdul Sattar bearing Employee ID 402436 was hired against the sanctioned position of Life Guard; however, the individual is performing the duties of a Driver at the branch. This indicates a misalignment between the approved position and the actual duties being performed.
observations.recommendation: Branch should ensure that employees are hired and recorded against the correct approved positions in accordance with the organizational structure and HR policy. In case of operational requirements, such as the need for a driver at the branch, the branch management should seek formal approval from the competent authority for creation or adjustment of the required position rather than appointing staff under an unrelated designation. Additionally, HR should periodically review branch staffing structures and actual job assignments to ensure alignment between approved positions and the duties being performed. Referred to Regional Office
observations.auditee_response: The pool facility operates seasonally from April to October. During the off-season, when the pool is non-functional, the lifeguard remains unoccupied. As the school does not have a designated driver position for the APV, this responsibility is managed through staff rotation based on skill. Accordingly, during the months when the pool is not operational, the lifeguard is assigned to drive the school APV. The individual assigned to drive the APV holds a valid driving license. We fully acknowledge the importance of the role of a life guard. The school recognizes the need for a more structured arrangement and will be discussing this with HR to explore a sustainable, long-term solution.

observations.title: Backup CCTV Camera not Provided by IT Solution
observations.description: Security cameras should be kept with proper care in working condition. During discussions with school security supervisor, it was revealed that backup of out of order CCTV cameras, sent to workshop for repair, were not provided by IT Solution. Further, SSS has also raised his concerns over the performance of IT Solution. IT Solution did not provide prompt response on complains raised with respect to CCTV cameras. They use to take action on complains raised after multiple reminders and follow ups (atleast 4 to 5).
observations.recommendation: Out of order CCTV Cameras should be repaired immediately and in case it requires to be taken to the workshop, backup cameras should be provided by IT Solution. As per clause # 5 of CCTV Repair Contract with IT Solution; “IT Solution agrees to provide back-up CCTV Cameras/NVR/XVR/POE Switches till the time the faulty equipment is repaired at the workshop or its replacement is provide (in case of irreparable).” Referred to Regional Office
observations.auditee_response: IT Solution has been reiterated and instructed to provide backup equipment during repairs and to respond promptly to complaints. Compliance will be closely monitored bthe branch administration.

observations.title: Poor Service by CCTV Camera Vendor - IT Solution

observations.auditee_response: IT Solution has been reiterated and instructed to improve response time and service quality, and branch administration will monitor compliance closely.

observations.title: Replacement not Provided by Security Company
observations.description: In accordance with the agreement for provision of security services between ESL and Karam Security Company (Pvt) Ltd., “The replacement of any ASG who absents from the duty on any ground, will be the responsibility of service provider”. During the course of audit, while reviewing attendance record of security guards, it was noted that, substitute guards were not provided by the security company in the absence of deployed security guards. Some of the instances are attached below: Sr. # Name of Security Guard Absent Days Status 1 Ismail 13/11/2024 To 21/09/2024 23/11/2024 To 26/11/2024 Alternate guard not provided 2 Ashraf 14/12/2024 & 15/12/2024 Alternate guard not provided 3 Habib 8/12/2024, 11/12/2024, 12/12/2024 Alternate guard not provided 4 Hamza 21/02/2024, 22/02/2024 Alternate guard not provided
observations.recommendation: Replacement of Security Guards may result in deployment of guards with in adequate security skills. It is quite likely that these guards may not be able to handle real emergency/security threat in an effective manner. Considering general security reasons rosters of specified Armed Guards should be handed over by the relevant security company to the branch. As per Security Manual Chapter -2 “New Security Paradigm – SOPs” clause # g (1) and Chapter -4 “Charter of Duties” clause # 18: “(Service Provider) maintain a separate pool for the BSS so as to create apermanency/continuity in the guards trained by us through daily rehearsals & wastage of our trained manpower being utilized elsewhere.” “Ensure that security companies providing security guards to BSS must maintain aseparate BSS pool for continuity of duty and do not change the guards very -frequently/ at will.” Referred to Regional Office
observations.auditee_response: Whenever the security guards are absent, we immediately contact the security company's supervisor for replacement because as per agreement of clause no. 20 security Company shall provide reliever with in two hour upon intimation. However, sometimes the security company failed to provide replacement. Manager M/s KARAM Security Mr. Saeed and Supervisor Ghulam Rasool informed about this matter.
